title: Grover Search with Semiconductor Spin Qubits at Ambient Conditions
summary: Grover's algorithm is executed on a commercial quantum computer based on nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond operating under ambient conditions, achieving fidelities up to $99.98\,\%$. Within a $N=8$ search space of three solid-state nuclear spin qubits, the measured success probabilities of finding a single or two marked states are $(77.3 \pm 3.4)\,\%$ and $(87.0 \pm 4.2)\,\%$, respectively. These values surpass published results for superconducting qubits or any quantum computer operating at room temperature.
